Subject: Stakeholder mapping & procurement steps — next steps

Thanks again for taking time today, Daniel — really appreciated the candid discussion. Quick recap and a few asks so we can move toward a scoped pilot: 

What we heard / goals:
- Pilot to measure latency and per-query cost for recommendations use case (store personalization)
- Expected traffic profile: 120 qps peak, 10k q/day average
- Success metrics: 95th percentile latency <200ms; cost/unit <= $0.004 per request

Open items / asks:
1) Can you share an org chart (or list of decision makers) and who the economic buyer is?
2) Procurement/Legal steps: who owns vendor security questionnaire and PO process? Any standard vendor terms we should be aware of?
3) Security: are there specific compliance artifacts you need (SOC 2 report, encryption/KMS details, data residency controls)?

Proposed next steps:
- If possible, share org chart and procurement contact by end of week (we can take a first pass at a mutual action plan).
- Introduce the economic buyer and procurement/legal owner so we can align on timelines and required artifacts.
- Follow-up 30-min call next week with Meera (economic buyer) + procurement to walk through pilot plan and timeline.

Attachments: n/a for now — happy to send a concise one-pager and a sample mutual action plan once we have the touchpoints.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0198
